title: Brown representability criterion for a right adjoint
statement: Let $F:C\to D$ be an exact functor between triangulated categories [def-pc-derived-category] (categories equipped with shifts and distinguished triangles) with set-indexed coproducts. If $C$ is compactly generated (generated by a set of compact objects) and $F$ preserves set-indexed coproducts, then $F$ has a right adjoint.
